title: 真实Git hideRefs评估：隐藏引用后验证直接OID请求与既有克隆，不能把不列出分支当撤回
body:
## 操作任务
实现audit(url,protected_ref,object_id,previous_clone)，只接受git://127.0.0.1回环服务、经git check-ref-format验证的完整ref和SHA-1/SHA-256提交OID。屏蔽系统/全局配置，清理继承GIT_*并只允许Git协议；不修改服务端repo或调用者配置。实际读取ls-remote --refs，分别从全新临时仓库按隐藏ref和OID发起fetch，并只读检查previous_clone是否已持有该提交。返回ref公告、按ref拒绝、按OID拒绝、旧克隆持有、总体保密是否建立、已覆盖协议面、未验证接口列表及建议。只要OID仍可取、ref仍可取或旧收件人已有副本，保密边界必须标False并建议独立仓库；所有结果只对本题Git协议端点有效，不推断HTTPS/SSH/平台API或备份。不得声称删除ref能召回旧克隆，不得把仓库ref列表隐藏当内容保密。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Git bare仓库/git daemon回环端点；先复制含敏感提交的既有克隆，再隐藏ref，验证新客户端公告、ref请求、tip OID请求及旧本地副本。只覆盖此Git线路，不测生产凭据、平台API或其他客户端；隔离测试在fixture仓库配置hideRefs，未接触OpsForge Git仓库/默认配置/凭据。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明对象、引用或协议的特有边界
交付正反例验收及来源记录
定义失败中止和共享历史保护规则

conversion.original_title: 托管仓库拟用hideRefs隐藏敏感分支，怎样交付能证明数据保密边界的评审？

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,socket,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')}
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid')
def git(*args,cwd=None,ok=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','protocol.file.allow=always',*args],cwd=cwd,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 if ok:assert p.returncode==0,(args,p.stderr)
 return p
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);bare=root/'private.git';work=root/'work';git('init','--bare','-b','main',str(bare));git('init','-b','main',str(work));git('config','user.name','Fixture',cwd=work);git('config','user.email','fixture@example.invalid',cwd=work)
 (work/'public.txt').write_text('public fixture');git('add','public.txt',cwd=work);git('commit','-m','public',cwd=work);git('remote','add','fixture',str(bare),cwd=work);git('push','fixture','main',cwd=work)
 git('switch','-c','private',cwd=work);(work/'secret.txt').write_text('fake secret payload');git('add','secret.txt',cwd=work);git('commit','-m','private fixture',cwd=work);secret=git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=work).stdout.strip();git('push','fixture','HEAD:refs/secrets/key',cwd=work)
 old=root/'old-recipient';git('clone','--no-local',str(bare),str(old));git('-C',str(old),'fetch','origin','refs/secrets/key:refs/remotes/origin/key')
 git('--git-dir='+str(bare),'config','--local','--add','uploadpack.hideRefs','refs/secrets/')
 git('--git-dir='+str(bare),'config','--local','uploadpack.allowTipSHA1InWant','false');git('--git-dir='+str(bare),'config','--local','uploadpack.allowReachableSHA1InWant','false')
 with socket.socket() as endpoint:endpoint.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=endpoint.getsockname()[1]
 daemon=subprocess.Popen(['git','daemon','--reuseaddr','--base-path='+str(root),'--export-all','--listen=127.0.0.1','--port='+str(port)],cwd=root,env=env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 try:
  url='git://127.0.0.1:'+str(port)+'/private.git';deadline=time.monotonic()+3
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if git('ls-remote','--refs',url,ok=False).returncode==0:break
   time.sleep(.02)
  expected=git('rev-parse','refs/heads/main',cwd=work).stdout.strip()+'\trefs/heads/main'
  assert git('ls-remote','--refs',url).stdout.splitlines()==[expected]
  print('NATIVE_HIDEREFS_OMITS_REF_ADVERTISEMENT',flush=True);print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:audit',flush=True)
  actual=task.audit(url,'refs/secrets/key',secret,old)
  assert actual=={'ref_advertised':False,'ref_fetch_denied':True,'oid_fetch_denied':False,'previous_clone_has_object':True,'confidentiality_established':False,'tested_interface':'loopback_git_protocol_only','untested_interfaces':['HTTPS','SSH','hosting APIs','archives and backups'],'recommendation':'keep sensitive objects in a separate repository with independently verified access controls'}
  fresh=root/'fresh';git('clone','--no-local',url,str(fresh))
  assert git('--git-dir='+str((fresh/'.git').resolve()),'cat-file','-e',secret+'^{commit}',ok=False).returncode!=0
  assert git('--git-dir='+str((old/'.git').resolve()),'cat-file','-e',secret+'^{commit}',ok=False).returncode==0,'already downloaded object was not recalled'
  assert git('--git-dir='+str(bare),'config','--local','--get','uploadpack.hideRefs').stdout.strip()=='refs/secrets/'
 finally:daemon.terminate();daemon.wait(timeout=3)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
